items.title: Stanley Black & Decker (SWK) Is Up 6.8% After Raising 2026 EPS Outlook And Boosting Payouts
items.summary: Stanley Black & Decker recently reported second-quarter 2026 results showing slightly higher sales of US$3,960.7 million and a sharp increase in net income to US$351.3 million, and the company raised its full-year 2026 GAAP EPS guidance range to US$4.60–US$5.45. Alongside stronger profitability, Stanley Black & Decker completed a US$250 million share repurchase program and increased its quarterly dividend to US$0.84 per share, underscoring management’s focus on returning cash to shareholders...
